findings.title: Sharded requests interpolate the same targets repeatedly
findings.body: This applies template variables and request filters to each target before shard selection, but every shard subrequest is then passed to `runSplitQuery`, which now unconditionally calls `applyTemplateVariables` again with the same `scopedVars` and `filters` (and this repeats for each shard batch/retry). Template expansion is not generally idempotent: ad-hoc filters can be inserted into the selector again, and a literal `$name` produced by a variable value can be treated as another template variable on the next pass. This can send duplicated or unexpectedly rewritten LogQL selectors for sharded queries. Preserve an already-interpolated marker/targets when delegating to `runSplitQuery`, or perform interpolation in only one of these paths.
